name: PEEYEW.net
outcome: 3 connected destinations for shopping, magazine content, and brand discovery.

caseStudy.problem: PEEYEW brings together a shop, magazine, and distinct visual identity. The experience needs to help visitors move between those destinations without losing the character of the brand.
caseStudy.whatWeBuilt: A connected web experience spanning the shop, PEEYEW Mag, and brand landing page, with a shared visual language across desktop and mobile.
caseStudy.results: The delivered experience brings 3 key destinations into one website: shop, magazine, and landing. The case-study gallery documents all 3 at desktop and mobile sizes. Business conversion and revenue data have not been supplied.
